commands.name: clean
commands.description: Remove fable_modules folders and files with specified extension (default .fs.js)

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help

options.name: --version
options.description: Print version

options.name: --cwd
options.description: Working directory

options.name: --outDir
options.description: Redirect compilation output to a directory

options.name: --extension
options.description: Extension for generated JS files (default .fs.js)

options.name: --sourceMaps
options.description: Enable source maps

options.name: --sourceMapsRoot
options.description: Set the value of the `sourceRoot` property in generated source maps

options.name: --define
options.description:
Defines a symbol for use in conditional compilation
-c|--configurationThe configuration to use when parsing .fsproj with MSBuild,
default is 'Debug' in watch mode, or 'Release' otherwise

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print more info during compilation

options.name: --timings
options.description: Print a per-phase timing and allocation report after each compilation

options.name: --silent
options.description: Don't print any log during compilation

options.name: --typedArrays
options.description:
Compile numeric arrays as JS typed arrays (default is true)
--clampByteArrays Compile byte arrays as Uint8ClampedArray, as canvas pixel data is (JavaScript and TypeScript).
Out-of-range values clamp to 0 or 255 instead of wrapping as on .NET

options.name: --temporal
options.description:
Represent DateTime, DateTimeOffset, DateOnly, TimeOnly and TimeSpan with the JS Temporal API
(experimental; needs a runtime with Temporal; JavaScript and TypeScript)

options.name: --watch
options.description: Alias of watch command

options.name: --watchDelay
options.description: Delay in ms before recompiling after a file changes (default 50)

options.name: --run
options.description: The command after the argument will be executed after compilation

options.name: --runFast
options.description: The command after the argument will be executed BEFORE compilation

options.name: --runWatch
options.description: Like run, but will execute after each watch compilation

options.name: --runScript
options.description:
Runs the generated script for last file with node
(Requires `"type": "module"` in package.json and at minimum Node.js 12.20, 14.14, or 16.0.0)

options.name: --yes
options.description: Automatically reply 'yes' (e.g. with `clean` command)

options.name: --noRestore
options.description: Skip `dotnet restore`

options.name: --noCache
options.description: Recompile all files, including sources from packages

options.name: --noPackageCache
options.description:
Type-check package sources instead of reusing them from Fickl's package cache
(JavaScript and TypeScript; the cache is keyed by package contents and options)

options.name: --declaration
options.description:
Also write a TypeScript declaration file (.d.ts) next to each JavaScript file,
describing what that JavaScript exports (JavaScript only)

options.name: --strictOptions
options.description:
Keep `Some null` apart from `None` for options of types that can be null, as .NET does,
by wrapping and unwrapping them at runtime (JavaScript and TypeScript; value options stay erased)

options.name: --server
options.description:
Compile through a background compile server that keeps check results between compilations,
so recompiling a project only rechecks what changed (also FICKL_SERVER=1; FICKL_SERVER=0 disables it)

options.name: --noGitignore
options.description:
Don't generate a `.gitignore` file in the `fable_modules` folder
(Useful when publishing the compiled output, e.g. to npm)

options.name: --exclude
options.description:
Don't merge sources of referenced projects with specified pattern
(Intended for plugin development)

options.name: --optimize
options.description:
Compile with optimized F# AST (experimental)
--lang|--language Choose wich languages to compile to
